node.statement: Let I be the finite index set and write q as a convex combination q = sum_i lambda_i p_i. By def-signed-idempotent every row p_i has total mass one, and by def-negative-mass its negative mass nu(p_i) := sum_j max(-P_ij,0) is at most delta. Coordinatewise convexity of x -> max(-x,0) gives q*1 = 1 and nu(q) <= sum_i lambda_i nu(p_i) <= delta. Consequently, for every coordinate subset U, q(U) >= -delta and p_f(U) >= -delta.
